DONT LOOK BACK — Psychological Horror
=====================================
To play: double-click DONT_LOOK_BACK.html (or .exe) — opens in browser.
No install, no internet required. Windows 64-bit compatible (Chrome/Edge).

Controls: WASD + Mouse, F flashlight, E interact, R anomaly / T clean, J journal.

Three endings: Escape / Truth (5+ docs + clean streak) / Consumed.
